suite: bitc: (the installed binary.s sha256 is recorded|a re-install records|a failed version check leaves|the record and a new)

mutants.name: the bitc record is not written (an empty file)
the bitc record is never moved into place
the bitc record hashes the old binary, not the new one
the bitc record is written before the version check
mutants.new:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/crewkit"; sha256 "$bin/.bitc.new" > "$HOME/.local/share/crewkit/bitc.sha256"
  local reported
  reported=$("$bin/.bitc.new" version --json 2>&1) || reported=""

mutants.name: the bitc record's mode is left to the umask
a new ~/.local/bin gets the umask's mode
